title: gitAuthArgs substring host check leaks service token to attacker hosts

evidence.text: The host check is a substring match, so a remote URL such as `https://github.com.evil.example/x.git` passes and receives the service token in an `Authorization` header. Any user who can register a repository can collect the token.
`gitAuthArgs` attaches the GitHub bearer token to any URL that merely contains `github.com`, including hosts an attacker controls.
`cloneRepo` passes the user-supplied `remoteUrl` straight to `gitAuthArgs` with the service token, so `git clone` sends the token to whatever host the URL names.

title: Unhandled user-fetch failures reject loadDashboard and crash the page

evidence.text: `fetchCurrentUser` rejects on any non-2xx status, and `loadDashboard` does not catch it.
evidence.suggestion: try { return await json<User>(res); } catch { return null; }

evidence.text: `loadDashboard` awaits `fetchCurrentUser` and `fetchUserList` with no error handling. A failed request from either one rejects the dashboard load, and the page never renders.
`fetchUserList` throws on any non-2xx response, so the admin page crashes when the session expires.

title: Repository id not validated, allowing path traversal in registerRepo/template routes

evidence.text: The repository id is stored with no character or path validation and later used as a directory name. An id such as `../../etc` or an absolute path such as `/etc` escapes the repositories directory on both the template route and the cache listing route.
The template route builds its base directory from the raw repository id. CLAUDE.md invariant 1 requires every route to validate repository ids before using them.

title: Store.deleteRepo filter lets non-admins delete system-owned repositories

evidence.text: The delete route applies no ownership check of its own and relies on `Store.deleteRepo`, whose filter lets a non-admin delete system-owned repositories.
For a non-admin caller the delete also matches rows whose owner is `system`, so any authenticated user can delete shared system repositories.

title: getBuild CI request has no timeout or abort signal

evidence.text: The CI build request has no timeout or abort signal, so a stalled CI response hangs every caller of `getBuild`.

title: ADMIN_CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 makes every client an admin for auditLog

evidence.text: The admin allowlist is `0.0.0.0/0`, which spans `0.0.0.0`–`255.255.255.255`, so every client address counts as an admin network and `auditLog` serves the audit log to anyone.

title: No tests for encrypt/decrypt round trip and tamper detection

evidence.text: No tests cover `encrypt` and `decrypt`, including the round trip and tamper detection.

title: getIssue Jira request has no timeout or abort signal

evidence.text: The Jira request has no timeout or abort signal, so a stalled Jira response hangs every caller of `getIssue`.

title: searchAssigned interpolates unescaped email into JQL query

evidence.text: `searchAssigned` puts `email` into the JQL string without escaping. A value containing `"` rewrites the query. Escape `\` and `"` before interpolating.

title: Store.findByName builds SQL by string concatenation (SQL injection)

evidence.text: `findByName` builds its SQL by string concatenation, so a repository name containing a quote injects SQL.

title: createFixTask race: task running before feedback written, stale emit

evidence.text: `createFixTask` inserts the task as `running` with `feedback: null` and writes the feedback in a second statement. `poll` can pick the task up between the two writes and run it without feedback, and `emit` sends `{ ...task }` with the stale `null` feedback.

title: Response body parsed twice in api.ts

evidence.text: The response body is parsed twice.
